program: Wingless RSI corrective tranche: residual magnitude calibration attribution
question: Within the exact R30-excluded candidate cases, do training-only net historical advantage magnitude conflict or prediction-magnitude extrapolation identify residual held-out calibration error after R31 showed that sign-count polarity does not?
hypothesis: R31 ruled out majority-positive sign count as a useful discriminator. Residual calibration error may instead arise when the unchanged R27 predictor disagrees with the magnitude-weighted net historical advantage, or when the predicted held-out advantage magnitude exceeds the entire training-manifest actual-advantage envelope. For each outer holdout, reproduce the exact R30-excluded non-equal candidate set, fit the unchanged R27 predictor on the other three manifests, freeze both magnitude diagnostics from training outcomes plus held-out features only, and open held-out outcomes only after all flags and predictions are frozen.

predecessor.eliminated_hypothesis: majority-positive training sign count identifies productive candidates inside the exact R30-excluded set
predecessor.strengthened_hypothesis: candidate calibration depends on magnitude structure rather than vote-count sign polarity

cause_effect_trace.observed_failure: R31's majority-positive subgroup was materially worse than the remaining R30-excluded candidates on both held-out positive rate and mean held-out actual advantage.

diagnostic_definitions.NET_MAGNITUDE_SIGN_CONFLICT: sign(predicted held-out advantage) differs from sign(sum of the three training-manifest actual advantages); the sum is magnitude-weighted and uses no held-out outcome
diagnostic_definitions.PREDICTION_MAGNITUDE_EXTRAPOLATION: absolute predicted held-out advantage exceeds max absolute actual advantage observed across the three training manifests

cause_effect_trace.exact_bounded_delta: diagnostic accounting only; unchanged manifests, candidate allocations, equal baseline, R27 model/features, budgets, capacity and held-out ordering
cause_effect_trace.qualification: same four sealed manifests, exact 1744 budget, deterministic double replay, full Go regression, READY_RESEARCH, all diagnostics frozen before held-out outcomes open
cause_effect_trace.held_out_result: compare flagged versus unflagged held-out predictor sign-error rate and mean absolute prediction error
cause_effect_trace.retain_revert: R32 cannot change allocator behavior. A supported mechanism may justify a separately preregistered magnitude-aware correction; mixed/negative does not.
cause_effect_trace.next_hypothesis: supported -> test only the supported magnitude-aware correction; mixed/negative -> continue residual calibration-structure attribution without capacity growth

frozen_reuse.model: unchanged R27 ridge fit and six features

diagnostic_definitions.R30_EXCLUDED: training actual-advantage signs are not exactly one distinct non-zero sign
diagnostic_definitions.NET_MAGNITUDE_SIGN_CONFLICT: sign(predicted held-out advantage) != sign(sum(training actual advantages))
diagnostic_definitions.PREDICTION_MAGNITUDE_EXTRAPOLATION: abs(predicted held-out advantage) > max(abs(training actual advantages))

outcome_definition.sign_error: sign(predicted held-out advantage) != sign(held-out actual advantage)
outcome_definition.absolute_error: abs(predicted held-out advantage - held-out actual advantage)

classification_rules.supported: valid AND at least one preregistered magnitude diagnostic has coverage>=0.20, flagged sign-error rate >= unflagged+0.15, and flagged MAE >= unflagged*1.25
classification_rules.mixed: valid AND at least one magnitude diagnostic has both flagged sign-error rate > unflagged and flagged MAE > unflagged but none meets all supported thresholds
classification_rules.negative: valid AND neither magnitude diagnostic has both directional enrichments
classification_rules.invalid: any parent, manifest identity, 1744 budget, candidate set, exact R30 exclusion reproduction, model/features, training-only magnitude calculation, held-out ordering, deterministic replay, capacity, provenance or accounting requirement fails

thresholds.provenance: reuse R29 enrichment thresholds; no threshold selected from R31 outcomes

rsi_success_note: R32 is calibration attribution on already studied manifests and cannot establish allocator success.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter manifests, candidates, exact R30 exclusion rule, R27 model/features, magnitude diagnostics, thresholds, budgets/capacity, held-out ordering, classification, or authority after primary output.
